name: @game-hub/game-stpetersburg
description: Saint Petersburg (1st edition) as a single in-workspace game package — the Track D legacy-migration (phase 4) retrofit. Four subpath exports over TypeScript source: ./engine (pure card-buying-engine rules core, with real hidden information — hands + rubles are secret, redacted by viewFor), ./module (backend GameModule — no routes, no dice: randomness is createGame + per-refill draws inside pure actions), ./client (UI GameClient — the 'Malachite & Gilt' board art), ./bot (AI deciding from the redacted view + self-play + bench). Depends only on @game-hub/kernel (+ React for ./client).
